content.title: About
content.content: Instant coffee, not reconstituted (5233) is a dry powder made from roasted coffee beans with most of the moisture removed. The powder retains the aroma and flavor of regular coffee and is ready to consume without adding water.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Instant coffee was first produced commercially in the early 20th century.
Spray‑drying or freeze‑drying processes preserve most of the aromatic compounds.
In many countries instant coffee is popular in offices and for outdoor activities because of its convenience.
Some brands add stabilizers to improve solubility and taste.
Instant coffee can be plain or flavored with sugar, cream, or other additives.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Improves concentration
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, increasing alertness.

items.title: Supports metabolism
items.content: Caffeine may boost metabolic rate and aid fat burning.

items.title: May reduce risk of certain diseases
items.content: Regular moderate coffee consumption is linked to lower risk of type 2 diabetes and some neurodegenerative diseases.

items.title: Convenient consumption
items.content: Instant coffee requires no special equipment, making it easy to include in the diet.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Added ingredients
items.content: Certain instant coffees contain sugar, cream, or artificial flavors, which may be undesirable for specific diets.

items.title: Loss of some beneficial compounds
items.content: The drying process can reduce the amount of polyphenols and aromatic substances.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee can increase stomach acidity, which may be problematic for gastritis sufferers.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Place the instant coffee into a cup and pour hot water (80‑90 °C) over it. Add sugar, milk, cream, or plant‑based alternatives as desired. For a richer taste, use 1‑2 tsp per 200 ml of water.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the package in a dry, cool place and seal it tightly after each use. Prevent moisture from entering to avoid clumping and loss of aroma.
